text.tspan: Join thousands of quantum researchers, developers, and physics enthusiasts at
Qiskit Fall Fest 2026. Explore real quantum hardware, pulse-level control,
and wave interference algorithms in a month-long celebration.

g.text: Executed on IBM Eagle & Heron QPUs
Run variational and pulse-level quantum experiments directly on utility-scale 127-qubit IBM Eagle and Heron processors with zero queue throttling.
Direct 1-on-1 office hours with Qiskit core contributors, IBM Quantum research scientists, and leading university quantum physics professors.
Master cutting-edge quantum error mitigation techniques: Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), and Pauli twirling.
Ready to compute in quantum phase space?
Registration grants full IBM Quantum lab credentials and discord gateway credentials.
Follow the interference pattern of keynotes, pulse workshops, and hackathon synchronization nodes.
Quantum Utility in the NISQ and Fault-Tolerant Horizon
Speakers: Dr. Alistair Vance (IBM Quantum Fellow) & Prof. Elena Rostova
Exploring multi-qubit entanglement verification, dynamical decoupling sequences, and the 10,000+ gate depth threshold.
Mastering Qiskit Runtime Primitives: Sampler & Estimator V2
Speakers: Qiskit SDK Core Architecture Team
Deep dive into isa circuit compilation, resilience levels 0-2, and zero-noise extrapolation pipelines on cloud backend.
Direct Pulse-Level Control & Qubit Hamiltonian Characterization
Calibrate microwave DRAG pulses, measure Rabi oscillations, and extract T₁/T₂ relaxation times on real transmon qubits.
Global Hackathon Challenge Reveal & Team Formation
Unveiling problem statements across 3 core tracks: Algorithms, Error Mitigation, and Pedagogical Visualizations.
Speakers: Keynote Jury & Quantum Community Leaders
Top 12 finalist project presentations, live jury deliberation, hardware compute grant announcements, and closing gala.
Build utility-scale quantum applications, invent novel error suppression protocols, or craft visual pedagogical tools.

Tackle physical noise on utility-scale QPUs. Design cus

g.text: Every accepted team receives instant cloud API credentials for direct physical hardware execution.
Teams may consist of 1 to 4 researchers. Solo submissions are fully welcomed.
All code must be public on GitHub with Apache 2.0 or MIT license before deadline.
Must use modern Qiskit 1.x syntax and Sampler/Estimator V2 primitives.
Include end-to-end execution cells and clear theoretical markdown narrative.
+ 10,000 QPU Secs & IBM Quantum Lab Residency
Instant hardware API key generation upon GitHub repository linkage.
Sync with 4,280+ active quantum researchers, join dedicated track Discord/Slack channels, and pair with IBM mentors.
Welcome everyone to QFF 2026! Heron QPUs are calibrated and runtime tokens are active.
If anyone needs help formulating the Pauli twirling pipeline in Qiskit 1.x, ping me in #track-b!
⚡ 48 new teams formed in the last 60 minutes. 320 mentors currently online.
